reason_for_repair: TOPA rechecked geographic and temporal provenance before scoring. Two hidden leakage problems were found: the 2011-2015 hydrophone network covered approximately 20N to 10S, while the clean 2023 Falkor EMARK and Hydra/Grappe Deux discoveries are north of 20N; and the apparently attractive Koralovoe/Molodezhnoe 13N fields were publicly announced before the InterRidge v3.4 cutoff, so they are not post-cutoff holdouts.

source_study.segment_framework: 169 second-order MAR segments from approximately 35N to 40S

vent_inventory_cutoff.dataset: InterRidge Global Database of Active Submarine Hydrothermal Vent Fields v3.4

target_reclassification.note: 2023 documented active black smokers at a site with earlier inactive sulfide knowledge; useful as activity-status/morphology control, not a clean new-location hydroacoustic test.

target_reclassification.reason: Rosgeologia publicly announced Koralovoe and Molodezhnoe on 2020-02-07, before InterRidge v3.4 completion on 2020-03-25. Later papers describe discovery during Cruise 41 in late 2019/2019-2020. Therefore the location was knowable before the frozen vent inventory cutoff even if omitted from that release.

important_method_lesson: OUT_OF_TIME_VALIDATION_REQUIRES_BOTH_INFORMATION_CUTOFF_AND_SENSOR_DOMAIN_MATCH. A later publication date does not make a field a future holdout if the discovery was already public before the cutoff, and a later discovery cannot validate a sensor-derived predictor where that sensor network did not cover the location.

inputs_allowed: pre-2023 ISC event history only if the metric is recoverable for the target segments
inputs_forbidden: 2011-2015 hydroacoustic rate where target lies outside network domain

repaired_validation_lanes.requirement: Discovery/location must be demonstrably unavailable before 2020-03-25 and independently confirmed after that date.
